cac:TenderingTerms.cbc:AcceptedVariantsDescription: A bench of recycled plastic slats.
cac:TenderingTerms.cbc:RecurringProcurementDescription: A next procedure in about four years.
cac:TenderingTerms.cbc:AdditionalConditions: Benches must carry the maker's serial number.

cac:RequiredFinancialGuarantee.cbc:Description: A bank guarantee for the tender.

cac:TendererQualificationRequest.cbc:CompanyLegalForm: Consortia must name a lead member.

cac:TechnicalEvaluationCriterion.cbc:Description: Three similar supplies in five years.

cac:FinancialEvaluationCriterion.cbc:Description: Yearly turnover of at least twice the estimate.

cac:SpecificTendererRequirement.cbc:Name: Certified timber
cac:SpecificTendererRequirement.cbc:Description: Slats from forests managed for regrowth.

cac:ContractExecutionRequirement.cbc:Name: Recycled steel
cac:ContractExecutionRequirement.cbc:Description: At least 30 % recycled steel in the frames.

cac:AwardingTerms.cbc:LowTendersDescription: Prices 30 % below the average are examined.

cac:AwardingCriterion.cbc:Name: Price
cac:AwardingCriterion.cbc:Description: The lowest total of unit prices.

cac:AppealTerms.cbc:Description: Appeals to the review board within ten days of the award.

cac:LotDistribution.cbc:GroupingLots: Lots 1 and 2 may be awarded together.

cac:TenderingProcess.cbc:NegotiationDescription: No negotiation: the award is on the tenders as submitted.

cac:ProcessJustification.cbc:ProcessReason: Value above the threshold for open procedures.

cac:EconomicOperatorShortList.cbc:LimitationDescription: No short list in an open procedure.

cac:OpenTenderEvent.cbc:Description: Electronic opening; tenderers may follow it online.

cac:OccurrenceLocation.cbc:Name: Lumeport Public Works Department, Civic Square

cac:AuctionTerms.cbc:JustificationDescription: The award uses quality as well as price.
